**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (preferred-level cure proposed).**

- **Responsive clause:** paragraph (h) (p0072) is the sole assignment provision; paragraph 4 (p0016–p0017) contains the termination triggers and has no change-of-control trigger.
- **Issue:** the no-consent carve-out (affiliate, purchaser of substantially all assets, merger successor) is mutual, so Kubient can transfer the Agreement away from us — including to an AP competitor — without our consent. The reasonableness standard on other consents is already in the clause and was left untouched.
- **Cure (2 surgical ops):** (1) narrow the carve-out to AP only, which leaves Kubient's assignments consent-gated; (2) add one short sentence barring Kubient assignment to an AP competitor and confirming that an AP change of control gives Kubient no termination right. AP's own affiliate/successor freedom is preserved; all unrelated text in (h) is retained verbatim.
